text:
sophie-partners: Heads up — Orion Systems is ready to start co-sell intake next week. Need quick agreement on lead ownership, account mapping, and the announcement cadence. Quick sync?

mike-sales: Thanks — propose this baseline: inbound product leads -> Redwood SDR; SI-originated opportunities -> SI attribution. Suggest a 14-day window for intake ownership to avoid churn.

jordan-salesops: We also need a CSV mapping + a partner tag in SFDC. Proposing queue name `orion-si-leads`. I can automate routing once we agree on fields.

ana-si: From Orion: we ask for co-ownership on named accounts they introduced. For demo bookings they arranged, Orion requests first-touch credit.

lee-legal: Two legal items: (1) MSA addendum to codify co-sell credits, (2) joint announcement clause — we require coordinated signoff. No public press without both parties' approval.

sophie-partners: Draft rules of engagement (quick bullets):
- attribution: "SI-originated" if contact exists in SI CRM before first Redwood outreach
- split credits for introductions if Redwood engages within 7 days of SI intro
- SFDC: assign to `orion-si-leads` queue and tag `orion-intro`
- joint announcements require PM + legal signoff 3 business days prior

mike-sales: Onboarding checklist idea: mapping CSV, contact list, Partner Portal SSO, demo playbook. Jordan — can you auto-tag leads when `partner_source = Orion`?

jordan-salesops: Yep. Workflow: if partner_source == "Orion" then set tag `orion-intro` and route to `orion-si-leads`. Sending a sample CSV snippet here: 

```
account_name,account_id,partner_introduced_on,initial_contact,partner_type,attribution,notes
Acme Corp,AC-001,2026-03-01,Redwood SDR,SI,orion-intro,"introduced by Orion rep: Sarah K"
Beta Retail,BR-222,2026-03-02,Orion AE,Hardware,orion-intro,"Orion arranged demo at beta site"
```

ana-si: CSV looks good. One ask: include `partner_type` since Orion also coordinates with hardware vendors; helps routing to the right partner manager.

sophie-partners: Good call — we'll add `partner_type` and `marketplace_channel` fields. Also note: Orion wants a coordinated demo + joint announcement at the trade show in 6 weeks — can we tentatively hold that window?

mike-sales: Blocking the date on our side. PMs — can you confirm feasibility (Dedicated capacity & demo infra)? Also check customer privacy for joint demos.

lee-legal: Confirmed — for customer demos we need opt-in and possibly a redacted dataset. I'll draft a short opt-in template and an MSA addendum.

jordan-salesops: Routing automation will be in place by Fri EOD. Tracking checklist: 1) SFDC tags & queue; 2) partner CSV; 3) MSA addendum; 4) announcement runbook; 5) demo opt-in template.

sophie-partners: :thumbsup: Thanks all. Proposed follow-up: quick sync Fri 10:00 to finalize handoff docs and announce to GTM.

mike-sales: Works for me.

ana-si: Works for Orion — I'll bring the contact list and one sample co-sell opp.

lee-legal: I'll join for the announcement and MSA bits.

deploy-bot: onboarding-docs.redwood.com/partners/orion created — invite sent to orion@orion.com
